label: GPT-6 Luna

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hey Nina, Derek Shaw with Brinewatch, you guys are a seafood wholesaler right?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Right fresh and frozen mostly to restaurants, 12 trucks.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Great, so I'm guessing temperature is a big deal for you right?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: It's everything. Fresh fish has to stay right around 32 degrees, and if it gets warm, the restaurants send it back.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Yeah, so that's exactly what we do. Our sensors track every compartment and the second something drifts you get a text. We've got a great app, the reporting is super easy and honestly most of our seafood customers see the difference in the first month.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We get two or three rejected deliveries a week right now.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Oh wow yeah so with us you'd catch those before they ever get to the restaurant, do you have any temperature monitoring today?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: The trucks have a display in the cab, but it doesn't record anything. Each rejected delivery costs us about $1200, so it adds up.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Totally, are you looking at other options?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We got a quote from Frostgauge last month. It was cheaper, but my drivers didn't like the app.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Yeah, we hear that a lot. Our app is way easier, the drivers basically don't have to touch it and it works without a signal which is huge for you guys.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We also do airport pickups twice a week, and those runs are the worst for temperature. The fish sits on the tarmac before we even get it.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Right yeah the sensors would catch that too, would you want to see a demo?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Maybe I'd have to run it by the owner, Frank. He signs everything.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Sure, does Frank usually move fast on stuff like this?

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Got it, well I'll send over some info and a few times for a demo and you can share it with Frank.
